sentences.text: A chartplotter shows your GPS position on an electronic chart.

You can enter waypoints and build routes, but before you follow a route, zoom in and check every leg for shoals, markers and obstructions, because a straight line between waypoints may cross a shoal or even land.
Cross-track error shows how far you are to the side of your intended track.
Vector charts may hide details when zoomed out.
The Coast Guard and the courts expect a prudent captain not to rely solely on any single aid, so cross-check the plotter with buoys, depths and visual bearings.
